using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        private class TestClusterProvider : ClusterProvider
        {
            public TestClusterProvider(ILoggerFactory loggerFactory) : base(loggerFactory)
            {
            }

            public bool TrySetSlotRangesResult { get; set; } = true;
            public bool ReserveDestinationVectorSetsResult { get; set; } = true;
            public bool TryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult { get; set; } = true;
            public bool BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionResult { get; set; } = true;
            public bool MigrateSlotsDriverInlineResult { get; set; } = true;

            public override Task<bool> TrySetSlotRangesAsync(string nodeId, MigrateState state)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(TrySetSlotRangesResult);
            }

            public override bool TryPrepareLocalForMigration()
            {
                return TryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult;
            }

            public override Task<bool> BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionResult);
            }

            public override Task<bool> ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(ReserveDestinationVectorSetsResult);
            }

            public override Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(MigrateSlotsDriverInlineResult);
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenTrySetSlotRangesFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var clusterProvider = new TestClusterProvider(loggerFactoryMock.Object)
            {
                TrySetSlotRangesResult = false
            };

            var migrateSession = new MigrateSession(
                clusterSession: null,
                clusterProvider: clusterProvider,
                _targetAddress: "127.0.0.1",
                _targetPort: 6379,
                _targetNodeId: "targetNode",
                _username: null,
                _passwd: null,
                _sourceNodeId: "sourceNode",
                _copyOption: false,
                _replaceOption: false,
                _timeout: 1000,
                _slots: new HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 },
                sketch: null,
                transferOption: TransferOption.SLOTS);

            // We call TryStartMigrationTaskAsync which triggers BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync in background
            await migrateSession.TryStartMigrationTaskAsync();

            // Wait a bit for the background task to run
            await Task.Delay(100);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to set remote slots")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenTryPrepareLocalForMigrationFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var clusterProvider = new TestClusterProvider(loggerFactoryMock.Object)
            {
                TrySetSlotRangesResult = true,
                TryPrepareLocalForMigrationResult = false
            };

            var migrateSession = new MigrateSession(
                clusterSession: null,
                clusterProvider: clusterProvider,
                _targetAddress: "127.0.0.1",
                _targetPort: 6379,
                _targetNodeId: "targetNode",
                _username: null,
                _passwd: null,
                _sourceNodeId: "sourceNode",
                _copyOption: false,
                _replaceOption: false,
                _timeout: 1000,
                _slots: new HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 },
                sketch: null,
                transferOption: TransferOption.SLOTS);

            await migrateSession.TryStartMigrationTaskAsync();

            await Task.Delay(100);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to set local slots")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
